record.title: Flexible Polymer Food Packs - Food Contact and Performance Requirements
record.description:
Covers flexible polymer films, pouches, and laminated packs intended for direct contact with dry, aqueous, or fatty foods under defined time and temperature conditions.

Applies to packaging materials used in food storage and distribution when the material is intended to contact food directly; does not cover reusable rigid containers or pharmaceutical packaging.

Key requirements: Materials shall meet specified composition and migration criteria for the intended food-contact condition.; Pack seams and closures shall maintain integrity during the declared service conditions.; Odour and appearance shall remain within defined acceptance criteria after conditioning.

Testing: Overall migration test using the specified food simulant and exposure condition.; Seal strength test for applicable pouch and bag constructions.
record.certification_applicability: Certification not automatically required by this standard alone; applicability depends on the product, applicable regulatory order, and conformity route selected by the organization.
